description_en: Upgrades the kubelet version (recommended to match the control plane version), operating system version, or container runtime version of a specified cluster node pool
description_zh: 您可以调用UpgradeClusterNodepool接口升级指定集群节点池的kubelet版本（建议与控制面版本一致）、操作系统版本或容器运行时版本
kebab_example: aliyun cs upgrade-cluster-nodepool --cluster-id c106f377e16f34eb1808d6b9362c90000 --nodepool-id np31da1b38983f4511b490fc62108a0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpgradeClusterNodepool

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to ignore warning-level pre-checks
parameters.name: ignore_warning_check

parameters.help_en: The system image ID of the node
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en: The Kubernetes version of the node. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2667899.html to obtain the current cluster version information from `KubernetesVersion`
parameters.help_zh: 节点Kubernetes版本。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2667899.html在0中获取当前集群版本信息
parameters.name: kubernetes_version

parameters.help_en: The list of nodes to upgrade. If not specified, all nodes in the node pool are upgraded by default
parameters.help_zh: 指定升级的节点列表。未指定时默认升级节点池内所有节点
parameters.name: node_names

fields.help_en:
The upgrade interval between batches. This parameter takes effect only when the pause policy is set to `NotPause`.

Valid values: [5,120]. Unit: minutes.

This parameter can be set to 0, which indicates no interval between batches
fields.help_zh:
批次之间的升级间隔时间。该参数仅在暂停策略为`NotPause`时生效。

取值范围：[5,120]，单位：分钟。

该参数支持设置为0，表示不设置间隔时间
fields.name: batch_interval

fields.help_en: The maximum number of nodes that are allowed to fail during the rolling update. Default value: 0, which indicates that the task fails if any node fails. If the value is greater than 0, the task fails and stops when the cumulative number of failed nodes exceeds this value
fields.help_zh: 允许滚动过程中失败的最大节点数。默认为0，即任一节点失败即判定任务失败；大于0时，累计失败节点数超过该值则整体判定失败并停止
fields.name: max_failed_nodes

fields.help_en:
The maximum number of nodes that can be updated in parallel per batch. Node pool updates are performed in batches.

Valid values: [1,10].

Default value: 10
fields.help_zh:
节点池内的节点更新分批次执行，该参数定义每批次最大并行更新的节点数。

取值范围：[1,10]。

默认值：10
fields.name: max_parallelism

fields.help_en:
The automatic pause policy during node upgrades. Valid values:
FirstBatch: Pauses after the first batch is complete.
EveryBatch: Pauses after each batch is complete.
NotPause: Does not pause
fields.help_zh:
节点升级过程中的自动暂停策略。取值：
FirstBatch：第一批完成后暂停。
EveryBatch：每批完成后暂停。
NotPause： 不暂停
fields.name: pause_policy

parameters.help_en: The runtime type. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2667899.html to obtain the runtime information from the runtime field
parameters.help_zh: 运行时类型。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2667899.html在runtime中获取运行时信息
parameters.name: runtime_type

parameters.help_en: The runtime version of the node. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2667899.html to obtain the runtime version information from the runtime field
parameters.help_zh: 节点运行时版本。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2667899.html在runtime中获取运行时版本信息
parameters.name: runtime_version

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use disk replacement for the upgrade. Valid values:
true: Uses disk replacement to upgrade the node pool. ACK reinitializes the nodes based on the current node pool configurations, such as logon method, labels, taints, operating system image, and runtime version.
false: Does not use disk replacement.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用替盘升级。取值：
true：使用，即通过替换节点系统盘的方式升级节点池，ACK将按照节点池当前的配置（例如节点登录方式、标签、污点、操作系统镜像、运行时版本）重新初始化节点。
false：不使用。

默认值：false
parameters.name: use_replace
